Title: MCP Integration Friction
Content: VS Code MCP configuration pointed at MemorySmith before the app exposed an MCP endpoint, which caused /mcp probes to return 404 or 405. MemorySmith exposes a small HTTP MCP-compatible JSON-RPC endpoint with tools for lexical search, semantic search, hybrid search, context packs, record lookup, source bundles, and source-link back-mapping. The workspace .vscode/mcp.json should point directly at http://localhost:5089/mcp.
